summary: Greene County Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, maintaining the annual rate of $0.40 per share. The dividend will be paid on May 29, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 15, 2026. The mutual holding company (MHC), which owns 54.1% of outstanding shares, will waive its receipt, with prior regulatory non-objection. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation event.
